title: Sectors Of An Economy
definition: Sectors of an economy represent the macro-level division of economic activities based on the nature of operations, ownership, working conditions, and use of natural resources. They provide the fundamental architecture for measuring National Income (GDP), employment distribution, and structural transformation.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (distinguishing between primary, secondary, tertiary sectors, organized vs. unorganized labor, and public vs. private assets) and GS Paper III (Structural transformation, employment elasticity, jobless growth, and manufacturing/service sector policies).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sectors Of An Economy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of macroeconomics and national income accounting
